conclusions.shared_instance: Same actual HolySite fullID maps to same object; associated faiths are references to that object. One physical inventory/slot set; faith recognition and benefits are separate questions.
conclusions.replacement_recipient: Valid command actor, not original donor, county holder or faith leader unless that character is actor. Direct remove also transfers to valid actor; invalid-actor fallback is not normal player success.
conclusions.displacement: A legal replacement can remove the shared slot artifact relevant to another associated faith. Source does not authorize arbitrary actor/action: original candidates/enshrine/removal rules and current UI still gate it.
conclusions.picker_objective: Type compatibility then empty/lowest object rarity; no new/old net strategic value, per-faith recognition, beneficiary set or replacement cost optimization.
conclusions.qualification: Source and existing reader contracts only; no new engine run, process read, build, source mutation, or live replacement claim.

minimal_shared_nonempty_replacement.require: Choose an already-associated >=2-faith HolySite S, actual fullID; read reciprocal faith references and same S inventory/slots on a stable paused revision. Pick nonempty slot k holding old A, with A owner7C=S. Never treat unknown as empty.

Current actual player owns different new B. Read current original candidates/permissions, select B and desired slot k via existing typed UI primitives, independently read both108/110. Require native action-context effective_slot=k and replacing_id=A, plus fresh source-bound preview SHA and true visible/enabled original button.

One existing enshrine_relic request: artifact=B, expected_effective_slot=k, expected_replacing_empty=false, expected_replacing_artifact_id=A, fresh preview SHA. Preserve every admission/stability/normal-rule guard. ACK alone is pending; unknown is never blindly retried.

Independent later stable readback: slot k=B; B owner7C=S and78 absent, B gone from player-owned; A owner78=actual actor and7C absent, A in player-owned and not site-equipped. Other slots unchanged; same shared S ID and associated-faith membership preserved. Record actual costs/effects independently.

This is minimal structural shared nonempty replacement evidence. To claim concrete other-faith gain/loss also read original per-faith recognition and actual beneficiary/modifier outcomes; runtime lane owns that gap. Dynamic sanctification list or rarity alone is insufficient.

agent_policy.plan: Keep one physical inventory keyed by session+HolySite fullID. Attach per-faith recognition/value views; do not clone slots per faith.
agent_policy.decide: Before replacement evaluate B contribution minus A loss for target faith and affected associated faiths, personal opportunity value, returned-A value, costs and diplomacy. Unknown observations stay unknown; present tradeoff before dispatch.
agent_policy.primitive: Reuse typed effective/replacing preview and expected_replacing_artifact_id. A pointer, cached candidate, native picker or ACK is never a strategic recommendation.
agent_policy.next_small_MCP_gap: Existing context reports player/county-faith recognition only. If an arbitrary associated-faith view is needed, extend that same source-bound reader with bounded fullID-validated faith observations and independent qualification; never infer arbitrary-faith value from sanctified list alone.
